notes.zh-CN: 新增交接/编辑回放 60k 字符上下文预算（先收紧截断，再按用户回合丢弃最旧转录），以及文件变更面板放大/恢复按钮。macOS universal 为开发签名且未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds a 60k-character context budget for CLI handoff and edit replay (tighten clipping first, then drop the oldest turns at user-message boundaries), plus a maximize/restore toggle for the changed-files panel. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
